text.description_html:
First Impressions 229-US5, Ornate 7 Inch Door Stop

This Decorative 7 Inch Ornate Door Stop is cast in solid brass and completed in an antique brass finish. It is easy to install and comes with the mounting hardware. An extra long door stop, it is typically used to keep a door from hitting a obstacle mounted on a wall.

Also available matching: Ornate Appliance Pull.

Specifications for the First Impression 299 Costume Made 7" Ornate Door Stopper:

  • Finish: Antique Brass
  • Material: Solid Brass
  • Total Length: 7"
  • Rosette Diameter: 2-3/4"
  • Bumper Color: White

No matter which finish you choose for the outside, it will still be solid brass material inside.

*Sold Individually
